diagnostic_gate_repair.counterexample: A located Not yet implemented message containing an otherwise accepted causal phrase satisfied the old manifest predicates.
diagnostic_gate_repair.repair: Add the already supported explicit implementation/unsupported exclusions while retaining causal inclusion predicates and source points/spans. A corpus regression exercises every actual negative contract with the counterexample.

descriptor_contract.source_validity: TYPE(*) assumed-rank forwarding to the BIND(C) assumed-type/rank receiver uses the standard CFI descriptor route. Scalar actuals and sentinels are initialized; no dimension or payload is dereferenced.
descriptor_contract.alias_mapping: All 21 integer ISO_C_BINDING flags match the corresponding Table 18.4 code order; all three real flags/code/sizeof entries align. Eligibility is category-separated supported-kind equality, not numeric code layout or sizeof alone. Supported CFI type macros are positive under 18.5.4 p8.
descriptor_contract.preflight: A separate standard-property profile checks optional default/double-real C mappings and default CHARACTER=C_CHAR before any descriptor call. Missing mandatory C_INT is an error, not a profile skip. The profile does not exercise descriptors or assumed-type propagation.
descriptor_contract.provisioning: The C build step requests fortran_binding_header. The selected Fortran processor is queried; only its ISO_Fortran_binding.h is copied into a private include directory. GNU standard headers are not placed ahead of the C companion's headers. Missing/ambiguous setup is a harness error, not fixture invalidity or optional-feature absence.
descriptor_contract.provenance: Compiler/case reports bind selected header path/hash/discovery/version text and C companion identity. Source header bytes are checked before staging and at snapshot confirmation; reference adjudication refuses missing or inconsistent resource evidence.
descriptor_contract.abi_limit: A matching header selection, version banner, kind probe or successful link is not proof of a compatible binary/module/runtime/companion ABI. The descriptor checks CFI_VERSION before later fields.
descriptor_contract.target_interface_failure: The frozen LFortran build produces descriptor version 20180515 while its advertised header requires 20260322. This remains a failure at tag 1/status 2, before local type/kind/elem_len propagation is assessed. No expected version or header was substituted.
descriptor_contract.qualified_reference_result: GNU and Flang both execute the unchanged descriptor checker successfully with their own automatically selected headers and Apple Clang 17.
descriptor_contract.derived_identity_limit: CFI_type_struct/CFI_type_other cannot identify arbitrary named derived types; no general derived identity or compatibility evidence is inferred.

canonical_link.finite_source_connection: Two explicit module-subroutine interfaces have one nonoptional scalar default-kind CHARACTER dummy with the same name and position, differing only in LEN. They remain TKR-compatible and fail C1514 distinguishability. The sole repair makes the second dummy rank one, creating the required distinction.
canonical_link.source_span: The declared lines 3-11 bind the generic declaration and both signatures. Wrong files, recovery outside the relation, source echoes and unsupported ambiguity reports cannot pass.
canonical_link.contract: Explicit finite case IDs, primary numbered owner, roles, phase and canonical source anchors; no fuzzy selectors, inferred dependencies, self/circular primary chains or duplicate compiler execution.
canonical_link.review_binding: The semantic link review binds its contents, target requirement and sources, pin, relevant source reviews, referenced case/input/profile/requirement fingerprints, execution groups and current fixture adjudications. Missing, stale, disputed or unreviewed prerequisites block current linked evidence.
canonical_link.workflow: Source review, current fixture observations/approval, then independent semantic-link adjudication. A compiler report cannot approve the connection.
canonical_link.counts: One linked finite facet, separate from direct authored facets and direct observed/passing effects. Linked observed/passing aggregation remains not-computed.
canonical_link.epic_limit: This milestone does not complete the broader source-use-graph, documentary/interface or aggregate contracts, including the 29 foundation facets.
